newsitem.title: HONG KONG: TNT launches PAK range in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: TNT launches PAK range in Hong Kong.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide(HK)LTD is launching an all-in-one express delivery pack in Hong Kong after successful trials in Singapore and Malaysia, Hong Kong country manager Bryan Chan said
The initial goal is to win 10 per cent market share sector in Hong Kong by 2000, he told a press conference.

The document 'PAK' up to one kg is priced at HK$114 each for any Asian destination, $170 to Europe and North America and $300 worldwide. Three 5kg, 8kg and 12kg 'FreightPAK' boxes also in the range include free insurance and automatic proof of delivery Chan said.
The pack is expected to be marketed soon in Taiwan and Korea while it is awaits government approval for launch in Japan, he added.
TNT is owned by the Dutch telecommunications and postal group
